results_numeric.quantity: Gas fraction of BH dynamical mass (north; south)

evidence.quote: 5%-11% (6%-89%) of the original dynamical mass measurement of the north (south) black hole is actually contamination by gas
the depletion timescales are therefore roughly 2 Gyr for the north and 5 Gyr for the south

findings_qualitative.value: CO(2-1) follows a clumpy ribbon between nuclei, while continuum peaks on the nuclei

evidence.quote: The CO(2-1) emission, on the other hand, follows a clumpy ribbon between the nuclei and gives little clue to the locations of the nuclei.

claims.hypothesis: Nuclear molecular gas inflates dynamical BH masses in NGC 6240
claims.experiment: Measure gas mass within 38 pc of each nucleus from ALMA CO(2-1) and continuum
claims.result: South: 6-89% of mass is gas; north: 5-11%
claims.finding: South BH mass brought onto scaling relations; north remains overmassive

evidence.quote: In the south nucleus, this measurement implies that 6-89% of the original black hole mass measurement actually comes from molecular gas

claims.hypothesis: Gas near BHs can fuel AGN on tens of pc scales
claims.experiment: Compare gas masses with accretion rates
claims.finding: Substantial central gas challenges Bondi-type prescriptions

evidence.quote: a Bondi-Hoyle type accretion prescription will substantially overestimate the accretion rates

limitations_admitted.value: Longest-baseline data have poorer phase stability so flux may be lost; masses conservative

evidence.quote: we expect our flux measurements to be low and thus our masses conservative

limitations_admitted.value: CO flux measured in projection, so CO masses may be upper limits

evidence.quote: one might consider the CO-implied mass measurement an upper limit
